name: It is important to learn English well.
trans: sentence. 学好英语很重要。

name: It is necessary for us to study hard.
trans: sentence. 我们有必要努力学习。

name: It is difficult to finish this work today.
trans: sentence. 今天完成这项工作很难。

name: It is impossible to do everything at once.
trans: sentence. 不可能同时做所有事。

name: It is interesting to learn a new language.
trans: sentence. 学一门新语言很有趣。

name: It is said that he is a great writer.
trans: sentence. 据说他是一位伟大的作家。

name: It is reported that the accident happened last night.
trans: sentence. 据报道事故发生在昨晚。

name: It is believed that health is more important than wealth.
trans: sentence. 人们认为健康比财富更重要。

name: It is well known that China has a long history.
trans: sentence. 众所周知，中国历史悠久。

name: It seems that he has forgotten our appointment.
trans: sentence. 他好像忘了我们的约定。

name: It appears that you are right.
trans: sentence. 看起来你是对的。

name: It happened that I was not at home then.
trans: sentence. 碰巧我那时候不在家。

name: It turns out that he was telling the truth.
trans: sentence. 原来他说的是真话。

name: It occurred to me that I had left the door unlocked.
trans: sentence. 我突然想起我没锁门。

name: It takes me an hour to go to work every day.
trans: sentence. 我每天花一小时上班。

name: It took him three years to write this book.
trans: sentence. 他花了三年时间写这本书。

name: It won't take long to finish the task.
trans: sentence. 完成这个任务花不了多久。

name: It is no use crying over spilt milk.
trans: sentence. 覆水难收。

name: It is no good staying up late every night.
trans: sentence. 每天熬夜没有好处。

name: It is worth reading this book.
trans: sentence. 这本书值得一读。

name: There is a book on the desk.
trans: sentence. 桌子上有一本书。

name: There are many people in the park.
trans: sentence. 公园里有很多人。

name: There is something wrong with my computer.
trans: sentence. 我的电脑出问题了。

name: There is nothing to worry about.
trans: sentence. 没什么好担心的。

name: There is no doubt that he will succeed.
trans: sentence. 毫无疑问他会成功的。

name: There is no need to hurry.
trans: sentence. 不必着急。

name: There is no point in arguing with him.
trans: sentence. 和他争论没有意义。

name: There used to be a cinema here.
trans: sentence. 这里以前有一家电影院。

name: There seems to be a mistake in this sentence.
trans: sentence. 这个句子里似乎有个错误。

name: There happened to be a doctor on the bus.
trans: sentence. 公交车上碰巧有一位医生。

name: Not only does he study hard, but also he is very kind.
trans: sentence. 他不仅学习努力，而且人也很好。

name: Not only did he pass the exam, but he also got the highest score.
trans: sentence. 他不仅通过了考试，还得了最高分。

name: Neither you nor I am wrong.
trans: sentence. 你和我都没错。

name: Either you come to my place or I go to yours.
trans: sentence. 要么你来我这儿，要么我去你那儿。

name: Both my parents are teachers.
trans: sentence. 我父母都是老师。

name: She is not only beautiful but also intelligent.
trans: sentence. 她不仅漂亮而且聪明。

name: He is such a good teacher that all students like him.
trans: sentence. 他是个好老师，所有学生都喜欢他。

name: The movie was so boring that I fell asleep.
trans: sentence. 电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

name: He spoke so fast that I couldn't follow him.
trans: sentence. 他说得太快了，我跟不上。

name: There are so many books that I don't know which to choose.
trans: sentence. 书太多了，我不知道选哪本。

name: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
trans: sentence. 如果明天下雨，我们就待在家里。

name: If I were you, I would accept the offer.
trans: sentence. 如果我是你，我会接受这个提议。

name: If I had known the truth, I would have helped you.
trans: sentence. 如果我知道真相，我就会帮你了。

name: Unless you work hard, you will fail the exam.
trans: sentence. 除非你努力学习，否则考试会不及格。

name: As long as you keep trying, you will succeed.
trans: sentence. 只要你继续努力，就会成功。

name: As soon as I get home, I will call you.
trans: sentence. 我一到家就给你打电话。

name: Although he is young, he knows a lot.
trans: sentence. 虽然他很年轻，但他懂得很多。

name: Even though it was raining, we went out.
trans: sentence. 尽管下雨，我们还是出去了。

name: No matter what you say, I won't change my mind.
trans: sentence. 无论你说什么，我都不会改变主意。

name: However difficult it is, I will never give up.
trans: sentence. 无论多么困难，我都不会放弃。

name: Where there is life, there is hope.
trans: sentence. 留得青山在，不怕没柴烧。

name: The more you practice, the better you will become.
trans: sentence. 你练习得越多，就会变得越好。

name: The earlier you start, the sooner you will finish.
trans: sentence. 你开始得越早，完成得就越快。

name: The more I read, the more I learn.
trans: sentence. 我读得越多，学到的就越多。

name: She is taller than her sister.
trans: sentence. 她比她姐姐高。

name: This book is more interesting than that one.
trans: sentence. 这本书比那本有趣。

name: He is the tallest boy in our class.
trans: sentence. 他是我们班最高的男孩。

name: This is the most beautiful place I have ever visited.
trans: sentence. 这是我参观过的最美的地方。

name: I prefer coffee to tea.
trans: sentence. 比起茶，我更喜欢咖啡。

name: I would rather stay at home than go out.
trans: sentence. 我宁愿待在家里也不愿出去。

name: I prefer to go there by train rather than by plane.
trans: sentence. 我宁愿坐火车也不愿坐飞机去那里。

name: It is better to do well than to say well.
trans: sentence. 说得好不如做得好。

name: I think that learning English is very useful.
trans: sentence. 我认为学英语很有用。

name: I believe that you can do it.
trans: sentence. 我相信你能做到。

name: I hope that you will have a great time.
trans: sentence. 我希望你玩得开心。

name: I wonder if he will come tomorrow.
trans: sentence. 我想知道他明天会不会来。

name: I don't know what happened.
trans: sentence. 我不知道发生了什么。

name: Can you tell me where the library is?
trans: sentence. 你能告诉我图书馆在哪里吗？

name: What he said is true.
trans: sentence. 他说的是真的。

name: Where we will go has not been decided yet.
trans: sentence. 我们要去哪里还没有决定。

name: The fact that he passed the exam surprised everyone.
trans: sentence. 他通过了考试这个事实让每个人都很惊讶。

name: The question is whether we should go there.
trans: sentence. 问题是我们是否应该去那里。

name: That is why I was late.
trans: sentence. 那就是我迟到的原因。

name: This is what I want to say.
trans: sentence. 这就是我想说的。

name: He who laughs last laughs best.
trans: sentence. 谁笑到最后，谁笑得最好。

name: The man who is standing there is my father.
trans: sentence. 站在那里的那个人是我父亲。

name: The book which I bought yesterday is very interesting.
trans: sentence. 我昨天买的那本书很有趣。

name: This is the best movie that I have ever seen.
trans: sentence. 这是我看过的最好的电影。

name: The girl whose father is a doctor is my classmate.
trans: sentence. 父亲是医生的那个女孩是我的同学。

name: I will never forget the day when I first met you.
trans: sentence. 我永远不会忘记第一次见到你的那一天。

name: This is the place where we first met.
trans: sentence. 这是我们第一次见面的地方。

name: There is no one but knows him.
trans: sentence. 没有人不认识他。

name: He is not the same man as he was ten years ago.
trans: sentence. 他和十年前不一样了。

name: Such people as he is should be respected.
trans: sentence. 像他这样的人应该受到尊重。

name: As is known to all, the earth goes around the sun.
trans: sentence. 众所周知，地球绕着太阳转。

name: As we all know, practice makes perfect.
trans: sentence. 众所周知，熟能生巧。

name: I will call you as soon as I arrive.
trans: sentence. 我一到就给你打电话。

name: Please wait until I come back.
trans: sentence. 请等到我回来。

name: I haven't seen him since I moved here.
trans: sentence. 自从我搬到这里就没见过他。

name: While I was reading, he came in.
trans: sentence. 我正在看书的时候，他进来了。

name: When you finish your homework, you can go out to play.
trans: sentence. 你做完作业就可以出去玩了。

name: Before you leave, make sure to turn off the lights.
trans: sentence. 你离开之前，一定要关灯。

name: After he had finished his work, he went home.
trans: sentence. 他完成工作后就回家了。

name: By the time you arrive, I will have left.
trans: sentence. 等你到的时候，我已经走了。

name: Every time I see him, he is smiling.
trans: sentence. 每次我见到他，他都在微笑。

name: The moment I saw her, I knew something was wrong.
trans: sentence. 我一看到她，就知道出事了。

name: Because it was raining, we stayed at home.
trans: sentence. 因为下雨，我们待在家里。

name: Since you are tired, you should take a rest.
trans: sentence. 既然你累了，就该休息一下。

name: As it was getting late, we decided to go home.
trans: sentence. 天越来越晚了，我们决定回家。

name: Now that you are here, let's start the meeting.
trans: sentence. 既然你来了，我们就开始开会吧。

name: He didn't come to school because he was ill.
trans: sentence. 他没来上学，因为他病了。

name: He is ill. That's why he didn't come to school.
trans: sentence. 他病了，那就是他没来上学的原因。

name: He studied hard so that he could pass the exam.
trans: sentence. 他努力学习以便能通过考试。

name: I got up early in order to catch the first bus.
trans: sentence. 我起得很早，为了赶上第一班公交车。

name: He speaks loudly so that everyone can hear him.
trans: sentence. 他说话很大声，以便每个人都能听到。

name: He is such a good student that all teachers like him.
trans: sentence. 他是个好学生，所有老师都喜欢他。

name: He worked so hard that he fell ill.
trans: sentence. 他工作太努力了，以至于生病了。

name: Although he is rich, he is not happy.
trans: sentence. 虽然他很富有，但他并不快乐。

name: However hard he tried, he couldn't solve the problem.
trans: sentence. 无论他怎么努力，都解决不了这个问题。

name: Whatever you do, do your best.
trans: sentence. 无论你做什么，都要尽力而为。

name: Whoever wants to go, please sign up here.
trans: sentence. 想去的人请在这里报名。

name: Whichever you choose, you won't be disappointed.
trans: sentence. 无论你选哪个，都不会失望的。

name: Whenever you need help, just call me.
trans: sentence. 无论什么时候你需要帮助，给我打电话就行。

name: Wherever you go, I will follow you.
trans: sentence. 无论你去哪里，我都会跟着你。

name: However much you spend, it won't be enough.
trans: sentence. 无论你花多少钱，都不够。

name: If I had time, I would go with you.
trans: sentence. 如果我有时间，我就会和你一起去。

name: If I were a bird, I would fly to you.
trans: sentence. 如果我是一只鸟，我就会飞到你身边。

name: I wish I could speak French fluently.
trans: sentence. 我希望我能流利地说法语。

name: I wish I had studied harder when I was young.
trans: sentence. 我希望年轻时能更努力学习。

name: If only I had a million dollars!
trans: sentence. 要是我有一百万就好了！

name: It's high time we started working.
trans: sentence. 是我们开始工作的时候了。

name: I would rather you didn't tell him the truth.
trans: sentence. 我宁愿你不告诉他真相。

name: He suggested that we (should) go there by bus.
trans: sentence. 他建议我们坐公交车去那里。

name: It is important that we (should) learn from each other.
trans: sentence. 重要的是我们应该互相学习。

name: The doctor ordered that he (should) stay in bed.
trans: sentence. 医生命令他卧床休息。

name: Had I known the answer, I would have told you.
trans: sentence. 要是我知道答案，我就告诉你了。

name: Were I you, I would take the job.
trans: sentence. 要是我是你，我就接受这份工作。

name: Should it rain tomorrow, we would put off the match.
trans: sentence. 万一明天下雨，我们就推迟比赛。

name: He must be at home now.
trans: sentence. 他现在肯定在家。

name: He can't be at home. The lights are off.
trans: sentence. 他不可能在家，灯都灭了。

name: He must have gone to bed.
trans: sentence. 他一定已经上床睡觉了。

name: He can't have finished the work so soon.
trans: sentence. 他不可能这么快就完成工作。

name: You should have told me earlier.
trans: sentence. 你本应该早点告诉我的。

name: You shouldn't have said that to her.
trans: sentence. 你本不该对她说那种话的。

name: He could have passed the exam, but he was too careless.
trans: sentence. 他本能够通过考试的，但他太粗心了。

name: You needn't have come so early.
trans: sentence. 你本不必来得这么早的。

name: I might have met him before, but I don't remember.
trans: sentence. 我可能以前见过他，但我不记得了。

name: The book was written by a famous writer.
trans: sentence. 这本书是一位著名作家写的。

name: The bridge was built in 1990.
trans: sentence. 这座桥建于1990年。

name: English is spoken all over the world.
trans: sentence. 全世界都说英语。

name: The problem must be solved as soon as possible.
trans: sentence. 这个问题必须尽快解决。

name: The work has been finished.
trans: sentence. 工作已经完成了。

name: The meeting will be held next week.
trans: sentence. 会议将于下周举行。

name: I had my hair cut yesterday.
trans: sentence. 我昨天剪了头发。

name: I had my bike stolen last week.
trans: sentence. 我的自行车上周被偷了。

name: It is said that he has been abroad.
trans: sentence. 据说他出过国。

name: He is said to have written three novels.
trans: sentence. 据说他写了三部小说。

name: The book is worth reading.
trans: sentence. 这本书值得一读。

name: The problem is worth discussing.
trans: sentence. 这个问题值得讨论。

name: The flowers need watering.
trans: sentence. 这些花需要浇水。

name: The room wants cleaning.
trans: sentence. 房间需要打扫。

name: He is easy to get along with.
trans: sentence. 他很容易相处。

name: The question is difficult to answer.
trans: sentence. 这个问题很难回答。

name: Learning English is not easy.
trans: sentence. 学英语不容易。

name: Reading is a good habit.
trans: sentence. 阅读是个好习惯。

name: Swimming is good exercise.
trans: sentence. 游泳是很好的锻炼。

name: It's no use complaining.
trans: sentence. 抱怨没有用。

name: Seeing is believing.
trans: sentence. 眼见为实。

name: Hearing the news, she burst into tears.
trans: sentence. 听到这个消息，她突然哭了起来。

name: Walking along the street, I met an old friend.
trans: sentence. 沿着街走的时候，我遇到了一位老朋友。

name: Given more time, I could do it better.
trans: sentence. 如果给我更多时间，我能做得更好。

name: Seen from the top of the mountain, the city looks beautiful.
trans: sentence. 从山顶上看，这座城市很美。

name: Having finished my homework, I went out to play.
trans: sentence. 做完作业后，我出去玩了。

name: Having been told many times, he still couldn't understand.
trans: sentence. 被告知了很多次，他还是不明白。

name: The man talking to our teacher is Tom's father.
trans: sentence. 和我们老师说话的那个人是汤姆的父亲。

name: The building being built will be our new library.
trans: sentence. 正在建造的那栋楼将是我们的新图书馆。

name: The book written by him is very popular.
trans: sentence. 他写的那本书很受欢迎。

name: I have a lot of work to do.
trans: sentence. 我有很多工作要做。

name: I have no choice but to wait.
trans: sentence. 我别无选择，只能等待。

name: I'm glad to see you.
trans: sentence. 见到你很高兴。

name: He is too young to go to school.
trans: sentence. 他太小了，还不能上学。

name: He is old enough to go to school.
trans: sentence. 他到了上学的年龄了。

name: To tell you the truth, I don't like it.
trans: sentence. 说实话，我不喜欢它。

name: To be honest, I have no idea.
trans: sentence. 老实说，我不知道。

name: To begin with, let me introduce myself.
trans: sentence. 首先，让我自我介绍一下。

name: To make matters worse, it started to rain.
trans: sentence. 更糟糕的是，天开始下雨了。

name: Only in this way can we solve the problem.
trans: sentence. 只有这样，我们才能解决问题。

name: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
trans: sentence. 我从未见过如此美丽的地方。

name: Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain.
trans: sentence. 我刚到就开始下雨了。

name: No sooner had I gone to bed than the phone rang.
trans: sentence. 我刚上床睡觉，电话就响了。

name: Seldom does he go to the cinema.
trans: sentence. 他很少去看电影。

name: Little did I know about the truth.
trans: sentence. 我对真相几乎一无所知。

name: So fast does he run that no one can catch up with him.
trans: sentence. 他跑得太快了，没人能追上他。

name: Not until he came back did I leave.
trans: sentence. 直到他回来我才离开。
